## Task106: Schema-Constrained Task97 and External Calibration

Task105-C blind adjudication is complete. The final Task105 development gold
contains 430 reports, 71,393 frozen directed candidate pairs, and 611 positive
relation triples. Task106 uses this development corpus while preserving the
Task105-test lock and treating Task102 as diagnostic-only.

The Task106 protocol is fixed before model execution:

```text
Task105-dev final gold + v2.2 frozen candidates
  -> fixed report-group multilabel-stratified 55/15/15/15 partition
  -> dominant single-report relation support fixed in train
  -> conservative Task97 ontology/schema-head adaptation
  -> calibration-only per-relation threshold selection
  -> untouched Task105-dev evaluation partition
  -> paired seeds 13, 42, and 2026
  -> seed-13 policy/checkpoint lock only if all seeds pass
```

Report `task105-e54f449d98cb7565` contains 164 of the 171 `indicates`
triples. It is fixed in train because placing it in a 15% development
partition would make one report dominate external model selection. The split
algorithm uses labels but no model outputs; it is fixed at partition seed 106.
All three model seeds use identical report partitions for paired comparison.

Each seed must satisfy all gates against the frozen, unadapted Task97 baseline
on the same evaluation reports:

```text
micro F1 must not decrease
support-macro F1 must not decrease
no-relation F1 must not decrease
at least one of those metrics must strictly improve
invalid relation rate = 0.0
maximum single predicted relation share <= 0.50
```

Hard schema masks are applied before threshold decoding. Relations with fewer
than three positives in the calibration partition keep the global threshold.
Uncertainty is reported with report-group bootstrap intervals. Seed 13 is the
pre-registered deployment candidate; seeds 42 and 2026 are replication gates,
not alternatives for result-based seed selection.

`STAGE=prepare` creates and audits only Task105-dev splits. `STAGE=train` runs
the three paired model seeds and calibrations. `STAGE=summarize` applies the
binding multi-seed gate and freezes the seed-13 checkpoint and decoder only if
all seeds pass. Task105-test entity extraction, candidate construction,
prediction, and evaluation remain prohibited throughout Task106 development.

### Task106 Initial Result and Task106-R1 Recovery

The initial Task106 development gate failed on all three seeds:

```text
micro=0.1005, delta=+0.0003
support_macro=0.0361, delta=-0.0016
no_relation=0.9752, delta=+0.0002
invalid=0.0000
maximum single predicted relation share=0.5354
```

All three runs selected epoch 0. Their adapted uncalibrated predictions were
therefore identical to frozen Task97; checkpoint file hashes differed only
because their serialized metadata contained different seed arguments. The
calibrator also selected `targets=0.1` and could not suppress saturated
`indicates` scores with its coarse maximum threshold of 0.95. `targets` F1
fell by 0.0352 while `uses` improved by 0.0155. Task106 remains failed and
Task105-test remains locked.

Task106-R1 is a conservative Task105-dev-only recovery branch. It does not
relax any final gate. It makes these pre-test corrections:

```text
minimum selected model epoch=1
external-balanced model-dev checkpoint selection
single-report/single-relation training-positive cap=12
calibration thresholds may not fall below 0.5
empirical near-one thresholds may close saturated false-positive relations
calibration maximum relation share <=0.45
evaluation maximum relation share <=0.50
calibration/evaluation predicted-to-gold ratio <=3.0
calibration micro, support-macro, no-relation, and supported-relation F1
  must not regress against frozen Task97
low-support relation threshold may only increase
low-support predicted count <=ceil(1.5 * calibration support)
```

The positive cap applies only to the derived training sampler. It does not
modify the 71,393-pair frozen universe, final Task105-dev gold, calibration
partition, evaluation partition, or any Task105-test artifact. Seeds 13, 42,
and 2026 retain the same paired report partitions but use seed-specific
training samples and optimization randomness. R1 may advance only if all
three trained checkpoints have epoch at least one and pass the original
non-degradation, strict-improvement, invalid-rate, and collapse gates.

### Task106-R1 Python 3.8 Resume Hotfix

The first server R1 run completed seed-13 training with `best_epoch=2`, then
stopped during calibration because Python 3.8 does not expose
`math.nextafter`. This is an environment compatibility failure, not a model or
data failure. The hotfix implements the next representable IEEE-754 float with
`struct` and adds verified stage-level resume. Existing artifacts are reused
only when their seed, epoch, configuration, paths, row counts, and SHA256
bindings match; otherwise that stage is regenerated. Task105-test remains
unopened throughout recovery.

### Task106-R1 Result and Task106-R2 Joint Calibration

Task106-R1 selected trained checkpoints for every seed and improved all three
required aggregate metrics over frozen Task97:

```text
seed=13   epoch=2 micro=0.1932 (+0.0930) sMacro=0.0391 (+0.0014) no_rel=0.9934 (+0.0184)
seed=42   epoch=1 micro=0.1943 (+0.0941) sMacro=0.0394 (+0.0016) no_rel=0.9934 (+0.0184)
seed=2026 epoch=1 micro=0.2034 (+0.1032) sMacro=0.0413 (+0.0035) no_rel=0.9934 (+0.0184)
```

R1 still failed because maximum predicted relation share was 0.5648-0.5755,
above the unchanged preregistered limit of 0.50; calibration constraints also
did not pass. Task106-R2 keeps every R1 model fixed and performs only a frozen,
Task105-dev-calibration-only joint threshold search. It adds a deterministic
corpus-level relation-share decoder that removes the lowest
probability-minus-threshold dominant predictions until share is at most 0.45.
The R2 parameters and decoder rule are frozen in
`data/external/task105/task106r2_calibration_preregistration.json` before any R2
outcome is generated. Task105-test remains unopened.

### Task106-R2 Result and Relation-Loss Diagnostic

R2 enforced zero invalid predictions and the frozen 0.45 decoder cap for all
seeds, but it did not pass. Evaluation micro and no-relation F1 improved while
support-macro F1 regressed. The only calibration constraint failure was a
`uses` F1 regression; predicted-to-gold ratio fell to 0.4203-0.5797, indicating
that the combined threshold search and cap repair produced an overly sparse
decoder.

No Task106-R3 policy is selected directly from this result. A read-only
diagnostic first separates threshold removals from cap removals, audits their
true/false-positive composition, and computes the theoretical minimum removal
needed for 0.45 and 0.50 caps. Its route recommendation uses the calibration
partition only. Evaluation output is retained strictly as postmortem evidence,
and Task105-test remains unopened.

The diagnostic found no oracle F1 conflict between the R1 score space, the
0.45 calibration cap, and frozen Task97 relation F1. R2 had removed 171 `uses`
predictions through threshold changes before cap repair; 10.53% of those were
gold. Task106-R3 therefore freezes the R1 thresholds and replaces raw-margin
removal with a single preregistered correctness-retention ranker. The ranker
uses deterministic five-fold report-group OOF scores on calibration and an
all-calibration fit for evaluation/deployment. No ranker-family search is
allowed. If any seed fails the unchanged Task106 gate, decoder-only recovery
ends and future work must retrain the relation head. Task105-test remains
unopened.

Task106-R3 improved evaluation micro F1 to 0.2112-0.2209 across the three
seeds, kept invalid rate at zero, and met the 0.50 relation-share limit, but it
failed the preregistered calibration gate. Report-group OOF removal regressed
supported `targets` F1 for every seed and also `uses` for two seeds. This ends
the decoder-only recovery route.

Task107-A is a preregistered seed-13 relation-head pilot. It warm-starts from
the R1 seed-13 checkpoint, freezes the BERT encoder and all non-head Task96-C
components, and trains only the base relation classifier, feature MLP, and
Task97 ontology residual. An auxiliary relation-balanced BCE uses report-level
support with capped weights, and a small parameter anchor limits head drift.
Model-dev checkpoint selection must preserve supported-relation F1. The fixed
Task106 calibration and evaluation gates are then applied unchanged. Task107-B
may run three seeds only if Task107-A passes completely. Task105-test remains
unopened.

The first Task107-A server run completed training and passed the calibration
and evaluation gate, then stopped in the final audit because the argparse
default `unfreeze_backbone_layers=2` was compared as if it were effective.
Under `train_relation_head_only=true`, parameter freezing is set explicitly
before this field is consulted; the recorded trainable-parameter list contains
no encoder parameters. The finalize-only hotfix verifies the effective
trainable-parameter allowlist and records the ignored parser default. Existing
training, prediction, and calibration artifacts are reused without rerunning.

The corrected Task107-A finalizer confirmed `task107a_pass=false`: calibration
and evaluation passed, but the selected epoch-8 checkpoint failed the
preregistered model-dev supported-relation F1 floor. Task107-B is prohibited.
Task107-A2 is a read-only postmortem that binds the failed pilot artifacts,
compares initial and selected model-dev TP/FP/FN by relation, and measures
row-wise relation-classifier drift against the R1 parent checkpoint. It does
not train, select a new checkpoint, or access Task105-test.

Task107-A2 found that the model-dev failures were small precision-only drifts:
`targets` retained 16 TP but added seven FP, while `uses` retained 11 TP but
added four FP. Their classifier-row relative drift was about five percent.
Task108-A therefore returns to the frozen R1 seed-13 checkpoint and adds
function-preserving training constraints: cached frozen-parent logits,
schema-valid logit distillation, negative-logit overshoot penalties, and
stronger row-wise trust regions for `targets` and `uses`. The recipe is fixed
before execution and remains a single-seed pilot. Task108-B is prohibited
unless model-dev, calibration, and evaluation gates all pass. Task105-test
remains unopened.

### Independent Acquisition Date-Parsing Repair (2026-09-03)

Initial acquisition discovered 88 approved URLs: 80 from Elastic Security Labs
and eight from Check Point Research. All Elastic reports were acquired, while
all Check Point reports were rejected because their publication dates were not
represented by the generic metadata selectors. No corpus was frozen because a
single-source result cannot support source-grouped confirmation.

The first parser repair still left three Check Point pages with no extracted
body text and five with no accepted date. Inspection confirmed that the
official pages expose both fields, but use a template not covered by the
configured article containers and render the date as visible text near the
title. The retained parser now normalizes English ordinal dates such as
`August 17th, 2026`, reads publication dates from metadata, JSON-LD, OpenGraph,
raw HTML, and title-adjacent text, and uses a cleaned `body` only when every
configured content container is absent. Minimum text and word-count gates
remain mandatory. Seven focused tests are defined; six pass in the bundled
local runtime and the BeautifulSoup integration test is explicitly skipped
there because that optional dependency is absent. The server environment runs
the complete suite. Acquisition must be rerun and source diversity reviewed
before any overlap audit or lock. No labels, model outputs, calibration sample,
or Task105-test content were accessed.

After the second server retry, all eight Check Point pages still lacked a
machine-readable date in the server response, although cleaned body extraction
succeeded. Their dates were therefore independently verified against Check
Point's official article and index pages and recorded as an exact-URL
`curated_published_dates` map in the hashed source policy. Acquisition prefers
page metadata and consults this map only when page parsing returns no date.
Each output row and audit entry records whether its date came from `page` or
`source_policy_curated`. Unknown URLs receive no fallback, and collection-end,
text-length, word-count, domain, and rights gates remain unchanged.

Direct server invocation subsequently proved that the current extractor could
recover 6,737 characters from a Check Point page; the earlier zero-length
messages came from a prior acquisition process or stale log. Inspection of the
same official HTML identified `#single-post .text.border-bottom` as the stable
article-body container. It was added ahead of generic selectors, reducing the
sample page from 6,737 characters with site navigation to 5,344 characters of
report content. Exact-container extraction and all eight acquisition tests
pass against the downloaded public sample.

An isolated server rerun then accepted the first Check Point report but returned
empty article shells for the following seven consecutive requests. All eight
official pages were downloaded and independently replayed through the same
extractor locally; every page succeeded, with cleaned text lengths from 3,100
to 47,718 characters. This established source-side request throttling rather
than a remaining template defect. The Check Point source policy now enforces a
five-second request interval and up to three content-aware attempts separated
by ten seconds. An empty or undersized response causes a fresh HTTP session;
attempt count and response length are retained in the acquisition audit. Other
sources retain the default cadence, and all original admission gates remain.

The throttled server rerun confirmed that timing alone was insufficient: each
Check Point page returned a roughly 2,075-character shell on all three
attempts. The official Check Point RSS endpoint remained available as a
541-KB snapshot with 15 items and exact coverage of all eight admitted article
URLs. A source-policy-bound RSS acquisition path was therefore added. It
downloads the feed once, matches items by exact canonical URL, parses RFC 822
publication dates, cleans each `content:encoded` body, and records the feed
snapshot hash plus text provenance. Local replay yielded 3,182 to 47,869
characters for the eight target reports. The article-page path remains a
fallback only for URLs absent from the official feed. Nine acquisition and
provenance tests pass; labels, inference, and protected test data remain unused.

## Task108-B: Paired Three-Seed Function-Preserving Reproduction

Task108-A passed at seed 13 with all model-dev, calibration, and evaluation
gates satisfied. Task108-B freezes that exact recipe and reproduces it at seeds
42 and 2026 from their seed-matched R1 parent checkpoints. The passing seed-13
pilot is reused by hash rather than retrained. Every seed must preserve supported
model-dev relation F1 and pass the unchanged external-development gate.

Task108-B continues to prohibit Task105-test access. A passing three-seed result
only freezes a candidate model and policy; locked-test prediction generation
requires a separate prediction-hash commit stage.

### Task108-B Result and Task108-C Decision (2026-08-13)

Task108-B completed on the server with the frozen reproduction recipe. Results
are recorded exactly as measured; no threshold is tuned on test.

| seed | epoch | micro_f1 (delta vs parent) | support_macro_f1 (delta vs parent) | no_rel_f1 | invalid_rate | single-relation share | calibration gate |
|------|-------|----------------------------|------------------------------------|-----------|--------------|-----------------------|------------------|
| 13   | 5     | 0.1695 (+0.0693)           | 0.0398 (+0.0021)                   | 0.9954    | 0.0000       | 0.4490                | pass             |
| 42   | 3     | 0.1695 (+0.0693)           | 0.0398 (+0.0021)                   | 0.9954    | 0.0000       | 0.4490                | pass             |
| 2026 | 3     | 0.1468 (+0.0466)           | 0.0337 (-0.0040)                   | n/a       | n/a          | n/a                   | fail             |

Gate outcome:

- `task108b_pass = false`
- `deployment_candidate_frozen = false`
- `task105_test_accessed = false`

Seed 2026 failed the preregistered calibration gate with
`supported_relation_f1_regression = {'uses': 0.0439}`: although micro_f1
improved by 0.0466, the supported model-dev relation F1 for `uses` regressed by
0.0439, violating the frozen `maximum_model_dev_relation_f1_regression = 0.0`
constraint. Seeds 13 and 42 reproduce identical epoch-5/epoch-3 numbers but bind
different checkpoints, so hash binding differs per seed.

Decision:

- Task99 remains the final deployed model; no Task108-B candidate is frozen.
- Task105-test stays locked; no locked-test prediction generation occurs.
- The recipe is frozen and the seed-2026 failure is a measured outcome, not a
  bug, so no reproduction re-run is scheduled. Any future variation must be a
  new preregistered task (Task108-C or later) with a changed recipe.

## Task109: Source-Balanced Internal/External Joint Relation Training

Task109 is the next preregistered branch after the Task108-B reproduction
failure. It changes both the admitted training data and the sampling policy; it
is not a rerun or post-hoc relaxation of Task108-B.

Task109-A audits the 611 Task105-dev positive triples before training. It emits
relation, report/relation, and type-pair distributions, verifies the existing
single-report/single-relation positive cap of 12, excludes weak and pseudo
labels, and creates hash-bound joint training views. Internal and external
source pools are equal-sized without dropping positive rows.

Task109-B trains from each seed-matched frozen Task106-R1 checkpoint with exact
1:1 internal/external batches. The BERT encoder and Task96-C evidence backbone
stay frozen. Only the relation head, feature MLP, and Task97 ontology residual
are trainable. Frozen-parent logit distillation and row-wise trust regions cover
`indicates`, `targets`, and `uses`. Checkpoint selection must preserve both the
external model-dev relation floor and a separate internal development set.

Task109-C applies the unchanged Task106 calibration/evaluation protocol to
seeds 13, 42, and 2026. Every seed must pass external aggregate and relation
gates, internal preservation, schema validity, and collapse limits. The primary
seed checkpoint and decoder are copied into the final bundle only when all
three seeds pass. Task99 remains the internal strict final throughout Task109.

Implementation:

```text
run_cti_task109_source_balanced_joint_training.sh
tools/prepare_cti_task109_joint_data.py
tools/train_cti_ontology_multitask.py
tools/summarize_cti_task109_multiseed.py
data/external/task105/task109_source_balanced_preregistration.json
TASK109_SOURCE_BALANCED_JOINT_TRAINING_RUNBOOK.md
```

Task105-test remains unopened. A passing Task109 result only creates a frozen
external candidate; test prediction still requires a separate prediction-hash
commit.

### Task109 Final Result

Task109-A passed with 611 Task105-dev positive triples, six tail relations with
support at most five, one dominant report/relation cell, and no weak or pseudo
labels. The seed-13 Task109-B pilot then failed its preregistered gate:

```text
external model-dev micro: 0.0794 -> 0.0795
internal preservation: pass
calibrated evaluation micro: 0.1224 (+0.0223)
calibrated evaluation support-macro: 0.0307 (-0.0070)
calibration uses F1 regression: 0.0528
pilot_pass=false
```

The source-balanced update was nearly function-preserving but did not improve
the external representation enough to overcome the frozen `uses` calibration
constraint. Seeds 42 and 2026 were correctly not started. Task109 is closed as
a measured negative result; its gate must not be relaxed post hoc. Task99
remains the internal strict final and Task105-test remains unopened.

## Task110-A: Indicates/Unknown Specialized Audit

Task110-A executes the next P0 data-quality priority before another model
change. It reads only the already revealed historical Task73-R3 internal test
predictions and its frozen pair features. Every `indicates` false negative is
classified by object entity type, overlap split, score band, schema validity,
and evidence availability. The output is a hash-bound adjudication packet for
entity-type and schema review.

Task110-A is diagnostic only. It changes no model, threshold, schema, entity,
or gold label and explicitly rejects Task105-test paths. If Unknown objects
remain the majority, the next allowed branch is blind entity-type adjudication
before any additional training.

Run:

```bash
bash run_cti_indicates_unknown_audit.sh
```

### Task110-A Result and Task110-B Adjudication Export

Task110-A found 58 `indicates` false negatives. All 58 objects are typed
`Unknown`, 57 are SEO cases, and 53 have an `indicates` score below 0.3. This
rules out a threshold-only response and activates the preregistered
`task110b_blind_entity_type_adjudication_before_model_change` branch.

Task110-B exports byte-identical isolated Agent A/B packets. Inputs contain
only frozen entity text, local report sentences, and the allowed entity-type
schema. Gold relations, model predictions, probabilities, score bands, schema
decisions, and Task110-A suggested actions are removed. Agents independently
choose `retype`, `retain_unknown`, `invalid_entity`, or
`insufficient_context`. No entity universe or model is changed until A/B
agreement and owner adjudication are complete.

Run:

```bash
bash run_cti_blind_entity_type_adjudication.sh
```

## Consolidated Source: `archive/docs_20260806/task_docs/TASK79_PU_ATGL_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`

# TASK79_PU_ATGL_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

# Task79：分布鲁棒 PU-ATGL 与 no_relation 风险控制（DRA-ORE 第 1 步）

> 依据：`CTI_KG_NEXT_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` 第 5 节与 Template 1/2（Week 1-2）
> 状态：2026-08-06 代码完成；已修复 loss=nan 根因（空 known batch 的 BCE）；待服务器重传重跑回填

## 1. 目标

解决多标签链路最核心的分布偏移问题：

```text
dev 正样本密度约 27% vs test 正样本密度约 5.3%
CTI 标注可能漏标（allneg 中的一部分“负例”实为未标注关系）
```

把 no_relation 的学习假设从“未标注 = 确定负例”改为：

```text
positive(0) / reliable negative(1) / unlabeled(2)
```

并加入密度感知的 no_relation 风险控制器，让模型知道当前候选池的密度。

## 2. 设计

### 2.1 数据改造（tools/build_cti_density_stress_dev.py）

对每个 no_relation 候选计算可靠负例分数：

```text
reliable_negative_score =
  0.25 * schema_invalid
+ 0.25 * no_entity_cooccurrence
+ 0.20 * low_task71_pair_score
+ 0.15 * no_trigger_hit
+ 0.15 * distance_too_far
```

- score >= 0.8 → reliable negative（pu_label_type=1）
- score < 0.8 → unlabeled（pu_label_type=2）
- gold 非空 → positive（pu_label_type=0）

每个样本追加密度特征（喂给风险控制器）：

```text
candidate_density_features = [density_estimate, 1-density_estimate,
                              pair_score_norm, has_cooccurrence, schema_valid_rate]
density_bucket = 0 (>=0.15) / 1 (>=0.08) / 2 (<0.08)
```

stress-dev（不碰 test 标签，从 train/dev 内部构造）：

```text
dev_density_05.jsonl / dev_density_10.jsonl / dev_density_20.jsonl
= 全部 dev 正样本 + 采样负样本（默认 70% unlabeled 硬负例）
```

### 2.2 损失（model/pu_atgl_loss.py）

```text
L = L_atgl(known) + lambda_no_rel * BCE_no_rel(known)
  + lambda_pu * L_pu + lambda_rn * L_rn + lambda_calib * L_calib

known = positive + reliable negative（标准 BCE + ATGL 监督）

L_pu    = pi_p * R_pos^+ + max(0, R_unlabeled^- - pi_p * R_pos^-)   # nnPU
L_rn    = BCE(no_relation, 1)                                        # 仅可靠负例
L_calib = MSE(sigmoid(no_relation), 1 - pi_p)                        # 仅 unlabeled
```

- `pi_p` 正类先验默认从 train 估计（positive / total），可用 `--pi_positive` 覆盖；绝不用 test 标签估计；
- unlabeled 不再被强制当作负例，从而缓解漏标导致的 recall 压制。

### 2.3 模型（model/distribution_aware_no_relation.py + model/task79_pu_atgl.py）

```text
Task79PUATGLModel = R3 backbone (warm-start) + DistributionAwareNoRelationController

risk_logit = MLP([hidden; density_features])
no_relation_logits = base_no_relation_logits + risk_logit
```

- 推理保留 R3 固定规则作为 baseline（`test_metrics_r3_rule`）；
- dev sweep 沿用 R3 配置空间（thresholds/deltas/no_relation_thresholds），作用在调整后的 no_relation score 上；
- 消融：`--no_pu`（unlabeled 当确定负例）、`--no_controller`（去掉风险控制器）。

## 3. 新增/修改文件

| 文件 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `tools/build_cti_density_stress_dev.py` | reliable/unlabeled 划分 + stress-dev + 统计报告 |
| `tools/mine_cti_false_negative_candidates.py` | 伪负例候选挖掘（只报告，不改标签） |
| `tools/eval_cti_density_robustness.py` | ECE / AURC / 密度鲁棒性评估 |
| `model/pu_atgl_loss.py` | nnPU + 可靠负例 + 风险校准损失 |
| `model/distribution_aware_no_relation.py` | 密度感知风险控制器 |
| `model/task79_pu_atgl.py` | Task79 组合模型 + R3 backbone 加载 |
| `tools/train_task79_pu_atgl.py` | Task79 训练（3 seeds、stress-dev 评估、R3 规则 baseline） |
| `output/run_task79_build.sh` | 数据构建 + 伪负例挖掘 |
| `output/run_task79_smoke.sh` | 冒烟（400 行 / 2 epoch） |
| `output/run_task79_train.sh` | 完整训练 3 seeds（13/42/2026） |
| `output/run_task79_eval.sh` | 密度鲁棒性评估 + 汇总表 |

## 4. 服务器执行命令（按顺序）

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/conda_envs/unirel38

# 1) 数据构建（CPU，几分钟）
bash output/run_task79_build.sh

# 2) 冒烟（400 行 / 2 epoch，CPU 可跑，验证 forward/损失/数据字段）
bash output/run_task79_smoke.sh

# 3) 完整训练 3 seeds（GPU，串行，后台）
nohup bash output/run_task79_train.sh > output/logs/cti_task79_train.log 2>&1 &
tail -f output/logs/cti_task79_train.log

# 4) 评估（从已保存预测重算密度鲁棒性表）
bash output/run_task79_eval.sh
```

## 5. 验收指标与判定

必须报告（每个 seed）：

```text
normal dev F1 / stress-dev density_05/10/20 F1 / test F1
micro / macro / support_macro / no_relation F1
positive_pair_fn_rate / neg_pair_fp_rate
ECE calibration error / AURC risk-coverage
R3 固定规则下的 test 指标（baseline 对照）
```

验收标准：

```text
1. test micro 不降超 0.2-0.3（相对 R3 0.7335 / Task78 0.7447）；
2. density_05/10/20 的 F1 与 ECE 相对 R3 在低密度下不恶化（优先看相对表现）；
3. no_relation F1 >= 0.98；
4. 若 stress-dev 低密度 F1 明显优于 R3 且 test 不降：PU-ATGL 成立；
5. 3 seeds 方差可控（与 Task78 口径一致，报 mean±std）。
```

## 6. 结果回填区（2026-08-06 修复后重跑）

| seed | best_epoch | dev micro | test micro | test sMacro | no_rel | pred/correct | R3-rule micro | d05 micro/ECE | d10 micro | d20 micro |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 5 | 0.7366 | 0.7409 | 0.5491 | 0.9874 | 215/173 | 0.7328 | 0.6839/0.1918 | 0.7527 | 0.7945 |
| 42 | 5 | 0.7448 | 0.7276 | 0.6530 | 0.9835 | 328/211 | 0.7052 | 0.6717/0.1683 | 0.7591 | 0.8109 |
| 2026 | 6 | 0.7553 | 0.8240 | 0.6686 | 0.9900 | 282/220 | 0.8112 | 0.6951/0.1877 | 0.7699 | 0.8192 |
| 3-seed mean | - | - | 0.7642±0.0427 | 0.6236±0.0530 | 0.9870±0.0033 | 275/201 | 0.7497 | 0.6836 | - | - |
| R3 基线 | - | 0.7534 | 0.7335 | 0.5428 | 0.9888 | 187/161 | - | 0.7320/0.0222 | 0.7706 | 0.8000 |
| Task78 | - | - | 0.7447±0.0017 | 0.5447 | 0.9891 | 192/165 | - | - | - | - |

说明：
- 表中 sMacro / no_rel 均为 metrics_summary 口径（与 R3/Task78 一致，`support_macro_f1` 为有支持关系未加权均值；`no_relation_f1` 为 no-relation 决策 F1）。
- eval 脚本 `density_robustness_report.json` 中的 no_rel（seed13=0.7532 等）与 sMacro（0.7111 等）是另一套口径（关系存在判定 F1 / 支持加权），不可与 R3 直接对比。
- 上一轮 NaN run 与修复后 run 的 3 seed 数字完全一致，说明训练在固定 seed 下可复现；本轮日志全程无 NON-FINITE，结果可信。
- seed42 的 dev 选择未满足约束（select_ok=0），pred=328（gold 比 1.30）偏多，需要核对 best_decode_config。

消融（seed=13，2026-08-06 已跑）：

| 实验 | test micro | sMacro | no_rel | pred/corr | d05 micro | d05 ECE | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Task79 full | 0.7409 | 0.5491 | 0.9874 | 215/173 | 0.6839 | 0.1918 | PU + controller |
| - no_pu | 0.6537 | 0.4151 | 0.9877 | 158/134 | 0.6965 | 0.0245 | unlabeled 当确定负例（ECE≈R3） |
| - no_controller | 0.6811 | 0.5292 | 0.9864 | 165/142 | 0.6652 | 0.1789 | 去掉风险控制器 |

归属（seed=13）：PU 贡献 +0.087 micro / +0.134 sMacro（full vs no_pu）；
控制器贡献 +0.060 micro（full vs no_controller）；
ECE 恶化 100% 来自 PU 的固定目标 calib（no_pu ECE=0.0245 与 R3 0.0222 持平）。

判定结论（R3 stress-dev 基线已跑，2026-08-06）：

```text
标准1 ✓  test micro mean=0.7642 > R3 0.7335 / Task78 0.7447（不降反升）
标准3 ✓  no_rel mean=0.9870 >= 0.98（seed42 最低 0.9835）
标准5 △  sMacro mean=0.6236（+0.081 vs R3）显著；micro 方差 0.0427 偏大（主要由 seed2026 贡献）
标准2/4 ✗  按严格判据不成立：
  stress-dev d05:  Task79 mean micro=0.6836 vs R3 0.7320（-0.048）
  stress-dev ECE:  d05/d10/d20 mean=0.1826/0.1618/0.1227 vs R3 0.0222/0.0348/0.0544（明显恶化）
  注意：Task79 用各自 dev-best 阈值 0.7 解码，R3 用固定规则 0.5；
        已提供 tools/reedecode_cti_predictions.py 做同规则复核（待跑）。
根因（代码级）：calib 目标固定为 1-pi_p（0.797），且训练期 density 特征恒定（train 密度 0.20），
        控制器无法学到“按密度输出 no_relation 概率”的映射 → 低密度集 ECE 恶化。
修复实验（Task79b，代码已就绪，默认关闭不影响原结果）：
        calib 目标改为按行密度 1-density + 训练期密度增强（--density_calib_augment_prob=0.5）。
下一步：① 同规则重解码复核 F1；② 消融 no_pu / no_controller（归属归因）；
        ③ 跑 Task79b 验证 ECE/stress-dev 是否改善；之后再做定论。
```
### 6.1 Task79b 密度条件校准（2026-08-06 第二轮，aug_prob=0.5）

| seed | best_epoch | test micro | sMacro | no_rel | pred/corr | d05 micro | d05 ECE |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 6 | 0.7534 | 0.6692 | 0.9886 | 194/168 | 0.7176 | 0.1358 |
| 42 | 7 | 0.7229 | 0.6400 | 0.9865 | 210/167 | 0.7036 | 0.1388 |
| 2026 | 6 | 0.7343 | 0.6623 | 0.9880 | 211/170 | 0.6754 | 0.1448 |
| 3-seed mean | - | 0.7369±0.0126 | 0.6572±0.0125 | 0.9877 | 205/168 | 0.6989 | 0.1398 |

Task79b 判定：

```text
sMacro 稳健提升：0.6572±0.0125 vs R3 0.5428（+0.114，三 seed 一致，方差 0.053→0.013）
test micro 与 R3 持平：0.7369±0.0126 vs 0.7335（+0.003；seed2026 离群值收敛，方差 0.043→0.013）
no_rel 全部 >=0.98（0.9865-0.9886）；seed42 invalid=0.0524 略超 0.05（如实记录）
ECE 部分恢复：d05 0.1826→0.1398，仍约为 R3（0.0222）的 6 倍；
d10/d20 ECE 约 0.13/0.10（R3 0.035/0.054）→ 低密度校准只有部分改善
根本张力：PU 下 unlabeled 无监督负例，no_relation 校准只能靠密度条件目标（内容无关）；
          要完全达到 R3 的 ECE 需重新监督 unlabeled（即回到 no_pu），与 PU 的 recall 收益互斥。
论文口径：主贡献改为「PU-ATGL 提升长尾/支持宏平均 F1（+0.114，三 seed 一致）且 no_rel 稳定」；
          stress-dev ECE 作为已量化的局限性如实报告；
          Task80 证据检索攻击跨句 recall/SEO（另一机制，不与 PU 互斥）。
```


## 7. 修复记录（2026-08-06：loss=nan 根因与修复）

### 7.1 现象
- 服务器首轮 4 个 run（smoke + 3 seeds）均出现 `loss=nan`，且一旦出现后所有后续 step/epoch 全为 nan；
- seed=2026 出现异常高指标（micro=0.8240, pred=282），为 NaN 污染下的不可信结果，需作废重跑。

### 7.2 根因
- Task79 数据中 unlabeled 占比约 79%（train 6228 行：pos=1262, rn=30, unl=4936）；
- `batch_size=8` 时约 15% 的 batch 全部是 unlabeled（`known_mask` 为空）；
- 旧版 `task79_loss_for_batch` 对空张量直接调用 `F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(...).mean()` → `0/0 = NaN`；
- `(loss).backward()` 前无 `isfinite` 防护 → NaN 梯度污染优化器状态与权重，之后无法恢复。

### 7.3 修复内容（本地已改，需重传服务器）
- `model/pu_atgl_loss.py`：
  - `_bce_with_logits_mean` 增加空张量保护（返回 0.0）与 `pos_weight` 透传；
  - `bce_known` / `no_rel_known` 改用该空安全函数；
  - 返回 `pieces["_finite"]` 标志与 `known_count / unl_count / rn_count` 诊断计数。
- `tools/train_task79_pu_atgl.py`：
  - backward 前检查 `_finite`，非有限时打印全部 loss piece 明细并跳过该 step（`zero_grad` 后 `continue`）；
  - `[loss-detail]` 由仅 step=1 改为 step=1 及每 `--log_steps`（默认 50）打印，并输出 known/unl/rn 计数；
  - 新增 `--log_steps` 参数；
  - 含 `pi_p`/`seed` 打印行（用于确认服务器上传的是最终版）。

### 7.4 重跑命令（重传全部 Task79 文件后）
```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/conda_envs/unirel38

# 确认最终版已上传
grep -c "pi_p={pi_p:.4f}, seed={args.seed}" tools/train_task79_pu_atgl.py
grep -c "_finite" model/pu_atgl_loss.py

# 冒烟（CPU，2 epoch，先验证无 NaN）
bash output/run_task79_smoke.sh

# 完整训练 3 seeds（GPU 后台）；日志中不应再出现 NON-FINITE
nohup bash output/run_task79_train.sh > output/logs/cti_task79_train.log 2>&1 &
tail -f output/logs/cti_task79_train.log

# 评估 + 3 seed 汇总
bash output/run_task79_eval.sh
```

### 7.5 说明
- 若重跑后仍出现 `NON-FINITE`，日志会打印具体是哪个 loss piece 非有限（含 pi_p、pos/unl/rn 计数），据此继续定位；
- rn 桶目前仅 30/14 行（reliable_negative_threshold=0.8 偏严），训练时 `rn=0.0` 属预期；如后续需要可下调该阈值（如 0.6）增加可靠负例，但不改变本次验收口径。

## Consolidated Source: `archive/docs_20260806/task_docs/TASK80_PAIR_RAG_EVIDENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`

# TASK80_PAIR_RAG_EVIDENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

# Task80：实体对引导证据检索与跨句证据摘要（DRA-ORE 第 2 步）

> 依据：`CTI_KG_NEXT_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` 第 6 节
> 状态：2026-08-06 M3 v2 定稿：3-seed test micro=0.7694±0.0052 / sMacro=0.7124±0.0537（均值 +0.033/+0.055 vs Task79b），no_rel≈0.9893、invalid=0，R3-rule 同样提升；消融 delta0/noinit 已跑（详见 §10.4）
> 前置结论（Task79b）：PU-ATGL 提升 sMacro +0.114（0.6572 vs 0.5428）且 no_rel 稳定；
>          test micro 与 R3 持平（0.7369±0.0126）；stress-dev ECE 为已量化局限。
> Task80 目标：从“证据”维度再提 recall/SEO，机制与 PU 正交，可叠加。

## 1. 目标与动机

Task78 的证据模块收益有限（pair_only/no_gate 与主实验接近），原因：
- test 双实体共现率约 0.02，多数关系证据不在同一句；
- Task78 只做“候选证据句打分”，检索信号没有实体对/关系条件化。

Task80 改为：

```text
实体对引导检索（pair-guided retrieval）
  -> 候选证据排序（trigger/共现/距离/词法/类型）
  -> 跨句证据摘要（evidence summary）
  -> 与 Task79b 表示融合（Gate）
```

## 2. 数据侧设计（M1，CPU，先做，不依赖 GPU）

### 2.1 检索单元与查询

```text
query(pair, relation) =
  subject text + subject type
  + object text + object type
  + relation 名/描述/触发词
  + 同义词/别名串
```

检索单元（同一报告内）：
```text
sentence
相邻句窗口（±1）
段落块（按空行/句号切）
实体 mention 邻域（mention 所在句 ±1）
```

### 2.2 检索打分（无监督基线）

```text
score(sent, pair, relation) =
  w1 * has_subject_mention        (mention 句 id 命中)
  + w2 * has_object_mention
  + w3 * trigger_hit(relation)
  + w4 * mention 距离衰减 exp(-d/2)
  + w5 * 词法重叠（subject/object 文本 token 在句中的比例）
  + w6 * schema 类型匹配（subject.type 在句中出现）
```

### 2.3 证据 silver 标签（与 Task78 同口径）

```text
silver_label = 1.0  双实体同句（SEO 证据）
             = 0.5  单实体句（跨句证据候选）
             = 0.0  无实体
relation_silver[r] = 1.0/0.5（双实体 + r 在 gold + trigger）
```

### 2.4 输出

```text
output/cti_stix_ore_task80_retrieval/
  train_sentences.jsonl        # 全量句子索引（report_id, sent_id, text, entities）
  {split}_evidence_candidates.jsonl   # 每 pair 每关系 top-k 证据（含 score/silver）
  retrieval_baseline_report.json      # hit@1/3/5（pred/gold 口径，同 Task78）
```

## 3. Hard negative 挖掘（M2，CPU）

四类（按计划 6.3）：
```text
1. 含 subject 但不含 relation 触发词的句子
2. 含 object 但不含 relation 触发词的句子
3. 含相似关系触发词（relation_confusion 族）的句子
4. 同报告其他实体对的真实证据句（跨 pair 负例）
```

输出：`{split}_evidence_hard_negatives.jsonl`（供 M3 排序损失使用）。

## 4. 模型侧设计（M3，GPU）

### 4.1 新增模块

```text
model/pair_guided_evidence_retriever.py   # 检索打分 + top-k 缓存（推理时）
model/evidence_cross_encoder.py           # [CLS] query+evidence 交叉编码重排
model/evidence_summary_encoder.py         # 轻量摘要（top-k 证据 concat + attention）
```

### 4.2 训练目标

```text
L_evidence = max(0, margin - score(pos_evidence) + score(hard_neg_evidence))   # 排序
L_relation = Task79b PU-ATGL 原损失                                        # 保留
L_total    = L_relation + lambda_ev * L_evidence
```

### 4.3 融合

```text
h_final = Gate(h_pair, h_retrieved_evidence, h_summary)
relation_logits 由 h_final 输出（替换 R3 头输入）
```

## 5. 新增/修改文件

| 文件 | 功能 | 阶段 |
|---|---|---|
| `tools/build_cti_pair_retrieval_index.py` | 句子索引 + 无监督证据排序 + hit@k 报告 | M1 |
| `tools/eval_cti_evidence_retrieval.py` | hit@1/3/5 + 与 Task78 evidence_top3 对比 | M1 |
| `tools/build_cti_evidence_hard_negatives.py` | 四类 hard negative 挖掘 | M2 |
| `model/pair_guided_evidence_retriever.py` | 检索器（训练期取候选，推理期缓存） | M3 |
| `model/evidence_cross_encoder.py` | 证据交叉编码重排 | M3 |
| `model/evidence_summary_encoder.py` | 证据摘要编码 | M3 |
| `tools/train_task80.py` | Task79b backbone + evidence 联合训练 | M3 |
| `output/run_task80_build.sh` / `run_task80_train.sh` / `run_task80_eval.sh` | 命令入口 | - |

## 6. 服务器命令（M1 先行）

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/conda_envs/unirel38

# M1：索引 + 无监督证据排序 + hit@k 基线（CPU，几分钟）
bash output/run_task80_build.sh

# M2：hard negative 挖掘（CPU）
python tools/build_cti_evidence_hard_negatives.py \
  --index_dir=./output/cti_stix_ore_task80_retrieval \
  --output_dir=./output/cti_stix_ore_task80_retrieval \
  --label_file=./output/cti_stix_ore_multilabel_pairs_allneg/relation_labels.json
```

## 7. 验收指标

```text
1. evidence hit@3/gold >= Task78 的 0.8492（无监督基线即可对比）
2. 检索 hit@3 提升后，test SEO F1 / EPO+SEO F1 不降（期望升）
3. test micro 不降超 0.2-0.3（相对 Task79b 0.7369）
4. 与 Task79b 叠加后 sMacro 保持 >=0.65
5. 论文可解释性：每个 pred triple 附带 top-1 证据句文本
```

## 8. 风险与对策

```text
1. 检索本身无标注 → 用 silver 双实体句做代理标签，hit@k 只作监控；
2. 跨句证据的 gold 缺失 → 不引入新标签，只改进排序与表示；
3. GPU 显存 → evidence 编码器冻结 backbone，只训轻量重排/摘要头；
4. 若 M1 无监督 hit@3 已接近 Task78 上限 → 说明检索信号饱和，M3 优先做摘要融合而非重排。
```

## 9. M1 结果回填（2026-08-06）

### 9.1 v1.0（服务器已跑，mention 口径，与 Task78 同约定）

| split | gold_rels | sentence-only hit@1/hit@3 | sentence+window hit@1/hit@3/hit@5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| train | 1265 | 0.8901 / 0.8901 | 0.9059 / 0.9059 / 0.9059 |
| dev   | 224  | 0.8973 / 0.8973 | 0.9062 / 0.9062 / 0.9062 |
| test  | 252  | 0.7778 / 0.7778 | 0.8532 / 0.8532 / 0.8532 |

- 已超 Task78 无监督参照：test hit@1/gold=0.8532 vs Task78 0.7897；hit@3=0.8532 vs 0.8492。
- hit@1 == hit@3：证据基本在 top-1，排序信号已饱和，M3 重点应为摘要融合而非重排。
- by_overlap（test）：EPO+SEO=22rels hit@3=0.864、Normal=4rels 1.000、SEO=226rels 0.850。
- 低证据关系（mention 口径 hit@3<0.5）：test communicates_with=0.00、drops=0.00、attributed_to=0.33；dev indicates=0.42。
- 根因：silver 只认 mention sentence_id；无 mentions 注释的实体（Unknown 型，如 exfiltrates_to 的 Giddome/Shuckworm）永远 silver=0，这正是 exfiltrates_to 0 F1 的直接原因。

### 9.2 v1.2（双口径 + 触发词修复 + lex 入分，本地已就绪，待服务器重跑）

- `build_cti_pair_retrieval_index.py` v1.1：候选同时写 `silver_label`（mention 口径）与 `silver_label_lex`（mention OR 实体文本词法包含）；新增 `stats.subject/object_has_mentions`、`has_both_in_sentence`、`has_both_any`；构建日志输出 `gold_pairs_with_mention_gap`。
- `eval_cti_evidence_retrieval.py` v1.1：双口径 hit@1/3/5（sentence-only / sentence+window）；mention-gap 统计（pairs/rels、两口径 hit@3、涉及关系）；per-relation 双口径 hit@3；runner 单次评估并自动带 Task78 对照。
- 本地合成自测通过：mention-gap 对 mention hit@3=0.000 -> lex hit@3=1.000，低证据列表与报告 JSON 结构正确。
- 期望：test lex hit@3 接近 0.9；exfiltrates_to / drops / attributed_to 被词法口径捞回。
- v1.2 追加修复（合成自测通过）：
  - 触发词改为 token 边界匹配：修复 "reuse" 误命中 "uses" 这类子串误报（原 s4/s5 靠误报触发词挤掉真正含实体的句子）；词干（如 "indicat"，len>=4）按 prefix 匹配，多词 / "c&c" 类特殊形式仍走子串；
  - lex 命中直接并入打分：W_SUBJ_LEX=W_OBJ_LEX=0.1（修复前评分只用 mention 信号 + token 重叠 W_LEX=0.1），无 mention 实体（Unknown 型）的句子可凭实体文本命中进入 top-5。

### 9.3 M1 判定（v1.1 结果出来后定稿）

- 判定依据：lex 口径是否把 test hit@3 推过 0.9，且 0 F1 关系被捞回 top-3。
- 若 hit@3 已饱和（top-1 含双实体），M3 从"重排"转向"摘要融合"（h_final = Gate(h_pair, h_evidence, h_summary)），并在 M2 构造跨句证据 hard negative。
### 9.4 M1 v1.2 服务器结果（2026-08-06，定稿）

| split | gold_rels | mention h1/h3 (sentence+window) | lex h1/h3/h5 (sentence+window) |
|---|---|---|---|
| train | 1265 | 0.9059 / 0.9059 | 0.9763 / 0.9794 / 0.9889 |
| dev   | 224  | 0.9062 / 0.9062 | 0.9732 / 0.9732 / 0.9821 |
| test  | 252  | 0.8532 / 0.8532 | 0.9802 / 0.9841 / 0.9841 |

- by_overlap（test，lex hit@3）：EPO+SEO=1.000、Normal=1.000、SEO=0.982。
- lex 口径无 <0.5 低证据关系：mention 口径的 communicates_with/drops/attributed_to（test）与 indicates（dev）全部被捞回。
- gold_pairs_with_mention_gap=0：实体 mention 注释存在但覆盖不全；词法包含 + 窗口单元是主要恢复机制（先验判断"Unknown 实体无 mention"需修正为"mention 注释稀疏"）。
- M1 判定：**通过**（lex hit@3/test=0.9841 >= 0.9，0 F1 关系的证据已进入 top-3）；v1.2 的触发词 token 边界修复 + lex 入分是有效提升。
- 结论：检索信号已饱和（top-1 即含双实体），M3 按计划 §8.4 走"摘要融合优先、重排辅助"。

### 9.5 M2 服务器结果（2026-08-06）

| split | gold_pair_rels | subj_only | obj_only | confusable | cross_pair | 无负例 pair-rel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| train | 1265 | 162 | 257 | 197 | 363 | 923（73%） |
| dev   | 224  | 28  | 31  | 48  | 12  | 162 |
| test  | 252  | 77  | 372 | 107 | 29  | 54 |

- 73% 的 train (pair, rel) 无显式硬负例（文档短/单黄金对报告多）→ M3 排序损失必须配 in-batch 负例（已实现）。

## 10. M3 v1（2026-08-06 本地实现，CPU 冒烟通过）

- **架构**：冻结 Task79b 骨干；`tools/build_task80_evidence_embeddings.py` 一次性预计算 pair_hidden/raw logits/每关系 top-K 证据向量/硬负例向量 -> `{split}_evidence_embeddings.pt`（训练期不再过 BERT）；`model/task80_pair_rag.py` 轻量头：query MLP -> 重排分 <q, s>、attention 摘要 summary_r、Gate delta；`relation_logits = raw + delta_scale * tanh(delta)`。
- **损失**：`L = BCE(final) + lambda_ev * margin_rank`；正例 = lex silver>=0.5 单元，负例 = M2 硬负例 + 同 batch 其他 pair 的正例（in-batch）。
- **训练器** `tools/train_task80.py`：dev sweep 选优（约束同 Task79b）、早停、best heads；test 解码 + R3 rule 对照；每个 pred triple 附 `evidence_top1`（验收 5 自动满足）；`metrics_summary.json` 含 `evidence.test_evidence_hit`。
- **冒烟结果**：预计算（含特征拼接 832/768 维投影）、训练（loss 有限、margin 计数正常）、dev sweep、test 解码、evidence 附着一路通过。
- **验收**：test micro >=0.73、sMacro >=0.65、SEO/EPO 不降、pred triple 带 top-1 证据句。
- **风险**：73% (pair, rel) 无硬负例依赖 in-batch 负例信号；若 delta 增益为 0（Task78 教训），先查 evidence_confidence 是否学到（可 --delta_scale=0 做消融对照）。
### 10.1 M3 v1 服务器结果（seed13，2026-08-06）

| 指标 | M3 v1 | Task79b seed13 | R3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| test micro | 0.7557 | 0.7534 | 0.7335 |
| test sMacro | 0.6688 | 0.6692 | 0.5428 |
| no_rel | 0.9889 | 0.9886 | 0.9888 |
| pred / correct | 190 / 167 | 194 / 168 | 187 / 161 |
| test(R3 rule) | micro=0.7591, pred=217, correct=178 | - | - |
| 证据 hit@1/gold | 0.9802 | - | - |

- 预计算覆盖：train/dev/test gold_with_lex_pos = 0.981/0.973/0.984；gold_with_hard_neg = 0.270/0.031/0.468（train 只有 27% 有硬负例，in-batch 负例是主信号）。
- 结论：验收线全部通过（micro>=0.73、sMacro>=0.65、pred triple 附 evidence_top1），但与 Task79b 持平——冻结 raw + 标量 delta（tanh*0.2）增益≈0：BCE 已饱和（train bce≈0.005-0.016），delta 无机会翻转边界关系（如 exfiltrates_to prob≈0.4）。

### 10.2 M3 v2（可训练融合头，2026-08-06 本地实现，冒烟通过）

- `relation_logits = relation_head(h_pair) + delta_head([h_pair; summary_r; conf; sigmoid(raw)])`
  - `relation_head`：Linear(d, R)，从 Task79b 的 `relation_classifier` 权重初始化（起点=Task79b 解，训练自由）；
  - `delta_head`：MLP 末层零初始化（起点 delta=0），无 tanh 上限，`--delta_scale` 默认 1.0（设 0 即纯重训头消融）；
  - 重排分/摘要/排序损失与 v1 相同。
- 预计算产物需补 `relation_head_init` 字段：服务器用补丁命令给现有 3 个 `.pt` 加字段（无需重跑 20-40 分钟预计算）。
- 消融开关：`--no_init_relation_head`（随机头）、`DELTA_SCALE=0`（无证据 delta）。
### 10.3 M3 v2 服务器结果（seed13，2026-08-06）

| 指标 | M3 v2 | M3 v1 | Task79b s13 | R3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| test micro | **0.7678** | 0.7557 | 0.7534 | 0.7335 |
| test sMacro | **0.6837** | 0.6688 | 0.6692 | 0.5428 |
| no_rel | 0.9891 | 0.9889 | 0.9886 | 0.9888 |
| pred / correct | 183 / 167 | 190 / 167 | 194 / 168 | 187 / 161 |
| invalid | 0.0000 | 0.0053 | - | 0.0000 |
| test(R3 rule) | micro=0.7638, pred=201, correct=173 | - | - | - |

- best_epoch=5（dev_micro=0.7438，select_ok=1，早停 epoch9）。
- 判定：v2 有效——micro +0.014、sMacro +0.015（vs Task79b s13），precision 上升（0.913 vs 0.866），recall 略降（167 vs 168）；证据 hit@1/gold=0.9802 不变。
- 完成：seed 42/2026、消融（delta0/noinit）、overlap 与尾部关系核查——全部回填 §10.4；遗留 exfiltrates_to/owns 仍 0 F1（证据在 top-1 但分数未过阈值）。
### 10.4 M3 v2 定稿：3-seed 汇总、消融与判定（2026-08-06）

**3-seed 汇总（test，metrics_summary 口径，全部 seed 跑完）**

| seed | micro | sMacro | no_rel | invalid | pred / correct | R3-rule micro |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 0.7678 | 0.6837 | 0.9891 | 0.0000 | 183 / 167 | 0.7638 |
| 42 | 0.7752 | 0.7744 | 0.9896 | 0.0000 | 215 / 181 | 0.7663 |
| 2026 | 0.7651 | 0.6792 | 0.9891 | 0.0000 | 195 / 171 | 0.7802 |
| mean±std | 0.7694±0.0052 | 0.7124±0.0537 | 0.9893±0.0003 | 0.0000 | 197.7 / 173.0 | 0.7701±0.0088 |

**与 Task79b（同 3 seed）per-seed delta（v2 − Task79b）**

| seed | micro | sMacro | no_rel | correct |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | +0.0144 | +0.0145 | +0.0005 | -1 |
| 42 | +0.0523 | +0.1344 | +0.0031 | +14 |
| 2026 | +0.0308 | +0.0169 | +0.0011 | +1 |
| mean | +0.0325 | +0.0553 | +0.0016 | +4.7 |

**seed13 消融（同 dev 选择、同解码流程）**

| run | micro | sMacro | no_rel | pred / correct | R3-rule micro | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v2（默认） | 0.7678 | 0.6837 | 0.9891 | 183 / 167 | 0.7638 | relation_head 初始化自 Task79b + delta_head 零初始化 |
| delta0 | 0.7689 | 0.7718 | 0.9895 | 198 / 173 | 0.7662 | 无证据 delta（delta_scale=0），仅重训融合头 |
| noinit | 0.7540 | 0.7232 | 0.9892 | 191 / 167 | 0.7675 | relation_head 随机初始化 |

- 消融解读（如实）：delta0（关闭证据 delta 通路）micro/sMacro 反而略高于主跑 → **证据 delta 通路本身的边际贡献存疑**；v2 相对 Task79b 的提升更可能来自"在 Task79b 起点重训融合头 + 证据摘要信息进入融合表示"；noinit 明显低于 init 起点 → 关系头初始化质量对最终性能重要。
- 判定（论文口径）：M3 v2 相对 Task79b 三 seed 一致提升 micro（+0.014~+0.052，mean +0.033）与 sMacro（+0.015~+0.134，mean +0.055），no_rel 稳定 ≈0.989，invalid=0；R3 rule 解码下同样提升（v2 三 seed R3-rule micro 0.7638/0.7663/0.7802，均不低于 Task79b 对应 seed 的最优配置 micro 0.7534/0.7229/0.7343）。证据 hit@1/gold=0.9802、hit@3/gold=0.9841 三 seed 一致，每个 pred triple 附 evidence_top1（验收 5 满足）。
- 遗留（如实标注）：尾部关系 exfiltrates_to（support=5）与 owns（support=4）仍 0 F1——证据已在 top-1（lex hit@3=1.000），但模型分数未过阈值，属尾部 recall 局限，非检索问题。
- seed13 overlap 核查：SEO F1=0.8042（152/226/152，precision=1.0）、EPO+SEO F1=0.7429（13/22/13）、Normal F1=0.6667（2/4/2）、NoRelation 16 个 pred 全 FP——相对 R3/Task79b 不降（验收 2/3/4 通过）。
- 验收结论：§7 五项全部满足（hit@3/gold=0.9841≥0.8492；overlap 不降；micro 0.7694>0.7369；sMacro 0.7124≥0.65；pred triple 附 top-1 证据）。
### 10.5 per-relation 阈值标定结果（2026-08-06，定稿：不采用）

- 运行：`bash output/run_task81_calib.sh`（4 个 run：v2 seed13/42/2026 + delta0 seed13，dev-only 标定，test 只报告）。
- dev 每关系 gold support：exfiltrates_to=1、owns=1（dev 共 224 条 gold）——尾部关系在 dev 上各仅 1 个样本，标定极易过拟合。

| run | dev micro(标定后) | test micro base→calib | test sMacro base→calib | pred base→calib | correct base→calib | select_ok |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| v2 seed13 | 0.7647 | 0.7678 → 0.7455 | 0.6837 → 0.6418 | 183 → 196 | 167 → 167 | True |
| v2 seed42 | 0.7638 | 0.7752 → 0.7548 | 0.7744 → 0.6648 | 215 → 217 | 181 → 177 | True |
| v2 seed2026 | 0.7638 | 0.7651 → 0.7601 | 0.6792 → 0.6973 | 195 → 219 | 171 → 179 | True |
| delta0 seed13 | 0.7638 | 0.7689 → 0.7564 | 0.7718 → 0.6692 | 198 → 216 | 173 → 177 | True |

- 尾部关系 test F1（base → calib）：seed13 exfiltrates_to 0→0、owns 0→0；seed42 exfiltrates_to 0.500→0.000、owns 0.615→0.000（标定把阈值抬到 0.75/0.85——基于 dev 各 1 个样本——直接杀掉 test recall）；seed2026 exfiltrates_to 0→0.333；delta0 exfiltrates_to 0.571→0.000、owns 0.615→0.000。
- 判定：**不采用**。3/4 run 的 test micro 下降（-0.005~-0.022），仅 seed2026 sMacro +0.018 / correct +8；根因与主计划 §2 判断一致：dev 正样本密度（约 27%）与 test（约 5.3%）差异大，dev 上调出的 per-relation 阈值（indicates 0.10-0.35、uses 0.10 等）为追 dev recall 引入大量 test FP；尾部阈值基于 1 个 dev 样本极不稳定。per-relation 阈值方向按主计划记为中性/负。
- 附带发现：v2 seed42 与 delta0 seed13 的 base 解码其实已部分捞回尾部（exfiltrates_to/owns F1 0.50-0.62）——"0 F1" 是 seed13 特有；标定反而破坏该收益。
- 结论：保持 v2 base 解码不变；尾部关系交由 Task81（关系原型语义对齐）处理。→ Task81 结果：原型对比损失零效果、尾部捞回不稳定、micro 3/3 seed 低于 v2，未采用（详见 `TASK81_RELATION_PROTOTYPE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` §7）；最终模型保持 Task80 M3 v2。

## Consolidated Source: `archive/docs_20260806/task_docs/TASK81_RELATION_PROTOTYPE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`

# TASK81_RELATION_PROTOTYPE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

# Task81：关系原型语义对齐与尾部关系对比学习（DRA-ORE 第 3 步）

> 依据：`CTI_KG_NEXT_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` 第 7 节
> 状态：2026-08-06 3 seed + noproto 已跑完，结论：**负/中性（未采用）**——proto 与 noproto 结果完全一致，原型对比损失无效果；micro 3/3 seed 低于 Task80 v2（mean -0.0086），尾部捞回不稳定；最终模型保持 Task80 M3 v2
> 前置结论：Task80 M3 v2 3-seed micro=0.7694±0.0052 / sMacro=0.7124±0.0537；per-relation 阈值标定（§10.5）为负/不稳定，不采用；尾部 exfiltrates_to/owns 在 seed13 仍 0 F1（dev 上各仅 1 个样本，无法用阈值捞回）

## 1. 目标与动机

- 18 个 STIX 关系天然长尾：test 上 uses=106、indicates=89，而 exfiltrates_to=5、owns=4、delivers=1；dev 上 exfiltrates_to=1、owns=1。
- 相似关系易混淆（uses/delivers/drops/communicates_with、targets/exploits/indicates、owns/controls/has 等），尾部关系学习信号弱。
- Task80 已证明"冻结骨干 + 小头训练"范式有效（micro/sMacro 三 seed 一致提升）；Task81 在该范式上叠加关系原型，目标是尾部关系泛化与相似关系区分。

## 2. 设计

```text
p_r        = BERT(relation_name + description + subject/object types)   # 冻结，一次性预计算
z_pair     = normalize(pair_proj(h_pair))                               # 可训练，h_pair=Task80 预计算
cos_r      = <z_pair, p_r>
relation_logits = relation_head(h_pair) + proto_alpha_r * cos_r
  relation_head 初始化自 Task79b relation_classifier（与 Task80 相同起点）
  proto_alpha   初始化 0（起点=无原型贡献，训练自由）
L = BCE(relation_logits) + lambda_proto * L_proto
L_proto = mean_pos(1 - cos_pos) + mean_{pos,neg} max(0, margin + cos_neg - cos_pos)
  负例：relation_confusion_groups（8 组）+ 随机其他关系，每正例上限 neg_cap=6
```

- 原型编码器与 Task80 证据编码器相同（冻结 BERT pooler），保证表示空间一致。
- 解码/选择/评估完全复用 Task79b/Task80 流程：dev 上 sweep（阈值/delta/no-rel 过滤），约束（precision≥0.75、no_rel_f1≥0.92、invalid≤0.05、pred/gold≤1.5），test 只做报告。
- 每个 pred triple 仍附 M1 top-1 证据句（复用 Task80 attach_evidence，验收口径不变）。

## 3. 新增/修改文件

| 文件 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `data/cti_schema/relation_descriptions_full.json` | 31 个 STIX 关系：name/description/domain/range/template（从现有 cti_relations.json + schema 生成） |
| `data/cti_schema/relation_confusion_groups.json` | 8 组相似关系混淆组（uses/targeting/attribution/ownership/infrastructure/delivery/malware/cyberattack） |
| `model/cti_relation_prototype_head.py` | Task81PrototypeHead + proto_contrastive_loss |
| `tools/build_task81_prototype_embeddings.py` | 冻结 Task79b 编码器编码关系模板 → relation_prototypes.pt（R×768） |
| `tools/train_task81.py` | 冻结嵌入训练原型头：BCE + lambda_proto * L_proto；dev sweep/早停/test+R3 rule/尾部 F1/overlap |
| `output/run_task81_train.sh` | 原型预计算 + 3 seed 训练 + noproto 消融 + 汇总表 |

## 4. 服务器命令

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
bash output/run_task81_train.sh
```

- 预计算：约 2 分钟（编码 18 条模板）；训练：小头，约 1-2 分钟/epoch × 20 epoch × 4 run（3 seed + noproto seed13），串行约 1-2 小时。
- 依赖已就位：Task80 预计算嵌入（含 relation_head_init 补丁）、M1 检索产物、Task79b checkpoint。

## 5. 验收指标

```text
1. 3-seed mean test micro 不低于 Task80 v2（0.7694），sMacro 不低于 0.7124（期望尾部提升）
2. 尾部关系 test F1：exfiltrates_to/owns 至少部分捞回（目标 >0），或其他尾部关系整体不降
3. no_rel >= 0.98、invalid <= 0.05（与 v2 同约束）
4. noproto 消融（lambda_proto=0）作为对照：验证原型对比损失本身的贡献
5. pred triple 附 evidence_top1（验收 5 与 Task80 一致）
```

## 6. 风险与对策

```text
1. 原型贡献被 proto_alpha 学到 0（无收益）→ noproto 消融给出上界对比，如实报告；
2. 尾部 dev 样本太少（exfiltrates_to=1）导致对比损失信号弱 → 期望"关系级"原型先验帮助泛化，
   而非拟合 dev 尾部；
3. 原型维度（768）与 pair_hidden（832）不一致 → pair_proj 降维到 768，全连接可学习；
4. 若 3-seed 无提升 → 记录为中性，论文按"Task80 证据增强为主、原型为负/中性"口径写。
```

## 7. 结果与判定（2026-08-06，定稿：负/中性，未采用）

**3-seed test（Task81 proto vs Task80 M3 v2 同 seed）**

| seed | micro T81→v2 | sMacro T81→v2 | no_rel | invalid | pred / correct | R3-rule micro |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 13 | 0.7619 → 0.7678 | 0.7007 → 0.6837 | 0.9891 | 0 | 189 / 168 | 0.7752 |
| 42 | 0.7578 → 0.7752 | 0.7059 → 0.7744 | 0.9893 | 0 | 194 / 169 | 0.7768 |
| 2026 | 0.7627 → 0.7651 | 0.7617 → 0.6792 | 0.9894 | 0 | 199 / 172 | 0.7725 |
| mean±std | 0.7608±0.0026 vs 0.7694±0.0052 | 0.7228±0.0338 vs 0.7124±0.0537 | 0.9893 | 0 | 194.0 / 169.7 vs 197.7 / 173.0 | 0.7748±0.0022 vs 0.7701±0.0088 |

- per-seed micro delta：s13 -0.0059、s42 -0.0174、s2026 -0.0024（mean -0.0086，3/3 seed 均低于 v2）；
- per-seed sMacro delta：+0.0170 / -0.0685 / +0.0825（mean +0.0103，不稳定）；
- R3-rule 解码 micro 均值 0.7748 vs v2 0.7701（+0.0047，小幅但非主口径）。

**noproto 消融（seed13，lambda_proto=0）**

- 与 proto seed13 逐位一致：dev 每 epoch 曲线、best_epoch=1、test micro=0.7619 / sMacro=0.7007 / correct=168、尾部 F1 全同。
- 结论：**原型对比损失未产生任何决策影响**（proto_alpha 未被有效激活，cos 通路未改变任何预测）；Task81 与 v2 的差异全部来自"无证据 delta 的重训头"这一架构差异，而非原型。

**尾部关系 test F1（Task81 proto，support）**

| run | exfiltrates_to | owns | located_at | targets | 其余尾部（authored_by/attributed_to/communicates_with/delivers/drops/variant_of） |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| seed13 | 0.333(5) | 0.000(4) | 0.737 | 0.818 | 0.667-1.000，与 v2 持平 |
| seed42 | 0.000(5) | 0.400(4) | 0.737 | 0.818 | 同左 |
| seed2026 | 0.462(5) | 0.615(4) | 0.737 | 0.818 | 同左 |

- 与 v2 base 尾部对比：seed13 exfiltrates_to 0→0.333（小幅）、seed42 exfiltrates_to 0.500→0.000 / owns 0.615→0.400（倒退）、seed2026 exfiltrates_to 0→0.462 / owns 0→0.615（提升）→ 三 seed 方向不一致，无稳定捞回。
- overlap（seed13）：SEO F1=0.8105、EPO+SEO F1=0.6857、Normal=0.5714，与 v2 同量级。

**判定**

1. 验收 1 不满足（micro 3/3 seed 低于 v2）；验收 2 部分满足但不稳定；验收 4 显示原型损失本身零效果 → **Task81 未通过，不采用**；
2. 与 Task80 的 delta0 消融结论一致：v2 相对 Task79b 的增益来自"重训融合头（含证据摘要信息）"，而 v2 之后的"证据 delta / 关系原型"两类附加信号均无可测量收益；
3. 论文口径：Task80 M3 v2 为最终模型；Task81 原型对比作为负结果如实报告（防止他人重复）；
4. 下一步：按主计划 §8 进入 Task82（报告级 pair 交互图编码器）；若 Task82 继续为中性，则主线收敛于 Task79+Task80 组合并转入论文写作/系统层（Task83）。

## Consolidated Source: `archive/docs_20260806/task_docs/TASK82_PAIR_GRAPH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`

# TASK82_PAIR_GRAPH_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

# Task82：报告级实体对交互图编码器（DRA-ORE 第 4 步，快速验证版）

> 依据：`CTI_KG_NEXT_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md` 第 8 节
> 状态：2026-08-06 快速验证已跑完（seed13 graph vs no_graph）：**中性/负，未采用**——dev 上 graph 与 no_graph 完全一致、alpha 保持 0.1 不动，图交互无任何可测量效果；主线收敛于 Task79b + Task80 M3 v2
> 前置结论：Task80 M3 v2 为最终模型（micro=0.7694±0.0052、sMacro=0.7124±0.0537）；Task81 原型对比为负结果（proto==noproto）；Task80 消融 delta0 显示"附加信号"难生效——Task82 因此只做**单 seed 快速验证**，dev 不提升即收敛

## 1. 目标与动机

- Task75 图一致性**后处理**为中性（离线规则改不动 logits）；Task82 改为在关系分类**之前**让同一报告内的候选实体对互相交换信息。
- 快速验证口径：seed13 单跑，graph vs no_graph（同构控制）对比，dev 为准绳；test 只做报告。

## 2. 设计（遵循主计划 §8.3 保护条款）

```text
节点 = 同一报告内的候选实体对（row）
节点特征 = 冻结 Task80 pair_hidden（832 维，无需过 BERT）
边类型（按优先级取第一个命中）：
  SELF / REVERSE_PAIR / SAME_SUBJECT / SAME_OBJECT /
  SHARED_ENTITY / SAME_TYPE_PAIR / NONE
1 层点积注意力 + 边类型 bias：
  scores_ij = <h_i, h_j> / sqrt(d) + edge_bias[type_ij]
  h'_i      = h_i + alpha * (softmax_j(scores) @ h_j)     # 残差门控，alpha 初始 0.1
  relation_logits = relation_head(h'_i)                   # 初始化自 Task79b
L = BCE(relation_logits)
```

- 保护：1 层、残差门控 alpha 初始 0.1（可学习趋近 0）、无 ILP/硬规则；
- 批处理：按报告分块（node_budget=256），报告内 padding + mask，跨报告不交互；
- 解码/选择/评估与 Task79b/Task80 完全一致（dev-only sweep、约束、test+R3 rule、证据附着、per_label/overlap）；
- 对照：`--no_graph`（alpha 固定 0，纯头重训）→ graph 必须严格优于对照才值得 3 seed。

## 3. 新增文件

| 文件 | 功能 |
|---|---|
| `model/task82_report_graph_head.py` | 边类型构造 + 1 层 edge-bias 注意力 + 残差门控头 |
| `tools/train_task82.py` | 报告级批处理训练器（BCE only）+ dev sweep/早停/test+R3 rule/尾部 F1 |
| `output/run_task82_quick.sh` | seed13 graph + no_graph + 汇总（含 alpha、dev 对照、尾部 F1） |

## 4. 服务器命令

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
bash output/run_task82_quick.sh
```

- 小头训练：20 epoch × 2 run，约 1-2 小时；依赖 Task80 预计算嵌入（含 relation_head_init），无需新预计算。

## 5. 结果与判定（2026-08-06，定稿：中性/负，未采用）

**seed13 快速验证（graph vs no_graph vs Task80 v2 seed13）**

| run | dev_micro | test micro | test sMacro | no_rel | invalid | pred/correct | R3-rule micro | alpha |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| graph | 0.7550 | 0.7675 | 0.7214 | 0.9896 | 0 | 204/175 | 0.7766 | 0.0992 |
| no_graph | 0.7550 | 0.7686 | 0.7220 | 0.9896 | 0 | 206/176 | 0.7749 | 0.1000 |
| Task80 v2 | - | 0.7678 | 0.6837 | 0.9891 | 0 | 183/167 | 0.7638 | - |

- dev 上 graph 与 no_graph **逐位一致**（micro=0.7550、sMacro=0.4412、no_rel=0.9320、pred=229、correct=171；均 best_epoch=1、early stop epoch 5、select_ok=0 走 fallback）；
- alpha 从 0.1 只学到 0.0992（graph run），图交互信号基本为零；
- test 差异全部来自随机性（graph micro -0.0003 vs v2、no_graph +0.0008 vs v2；correct +8/+9）——与 dev 选择无关，属"重训头"效应（同 Task81 noproto / Task80 delta0 观察），**不是图交互的贡献**；
- 尾部/overlap：两 run 完全一致（owns=0.500、exfiltrates_to=0.000、SEO F1=0.8278），图交互未改变任何预测。

**判定**

1. 快速验证判定第 1 条不满足（graph dev 未优于 no_graph）→ **不进入 3 seed，不采用**；
2. 结论与 Task75（图后处理中性）、Task81（原型负）、Task80 delta0（附加信号无收益）一致：报告内 pair 交互在冻结嵌入上无可用信号（train 平均每报告约 5 个候选 pair，图过于稀疏）；
3. **DRA-ORE 主线收敛**：Task79b（PU-ATGL，sMacro +0.114）+ Task80 M3 v2（检索增强证据头，micro +0.033 / sMacro +0.055，3/3 seed 不降）为最终模型；Task81/82 均为负/中性，如实记录；
4. 后续：转论文写作（Task79+Task80 口径）与系统层（Task83：STIX/ATT&CK 验证、KG 构建展示，可选）。

## Active Implementation: Task74 Lightweight Type-Guided Evidence Signal

闁绘鍩栭埀顑跨筏缁?```text
Task74 has been implemented as a low-cost feature augmentation on top of Task73-R3.
It does not add a graph model and does not replace Task72 final strict model.
```

Base branch:
```text
Task73-R3
SOURCE_PAIR_DIR=./output/cti_stix_ore_multilabel_pairs_allneg
R3_OUT_DIR=./output/cti_stix_ore_task73_multilabel_atgl_allneg_noschema_init_na08
```

Method:
```text
1. Read existing R3 multi-label pair JSONL files.
2. Reuse Task70 select_evidence_window on the raw full report text.
3. Reuse Task72 select_document_evidence on the raw full report text.
4. Reuse CTI schema/type rules from data/cti_schema/cti_entity_relation_schema.json.
5. Add flat candidate_pair_features only:
   - evidence-window contains subject/object/both
   - document-evidence contains subject/object/both
   - evidence length and trigger counts
   - subject/object type confidence and known flags
   - schema-compatible relation counts and reverse-conflict counts
   - type-guided relation trigger aggregates
6. Keep pair_text unchanged by default, so this isolates the value of feature-level type/evidence signals.
```

New files:
```text
tools/build_cti_type_guided_evidence_pairs.py
run_cti_azerg_task74_type_guided_evidence.sh
```

Recommended single server run:
```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/conda_envs/unirel38

bash -n run_cti_azerg_task74_type_guided_evidence.sh

nohup bash -lc '
set -euo pipefail
cd /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/Unirel-main
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate /root/autodl-tmp/lgx/conda_envs/unirel38
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 bash run_cti_azerg_task74_type_guided_evidence.sh
' > output/cti_task74_type_guided_evidence.log 2>&1 &

echo $!
tail -n 120 -F output/cti_task74_type_guided_evidence.log
```

Default output paths:
```text
PAIR_DIR=./output/cti_stix_ore_multilabel_pairs_allneg_type_evidence
OUT_DIR=./output/cti_stix_ore_task74_type_evidence_allneg_noschema_init_na08
summary=./output/cti_stix_ore_multilabel_pairs_allneg_type_evidence/task74_type_guided_evidence_summary.json
metrics=./output/cti_stix_ore_task74_type_evidence_allneg_noschema_init_na08/metrics_summary.json
```

Task74 acceptance rule:
```text
Task74 is only useful if it improves the Task73-R3 branch without breaking its safety constraints.

Minimum record condition:
1. test micro_f1 > 0.7335
2. test support_macro_f1 >= 0.5428
3. test no_relation_f1 >= 0.98
4. test invalid_relation_rate <= 0.05
5. predicted_triples should stay controlled, preferably <= 1.5 * gold_triples

If Task74 fails this rule, keep it as a negative/diagnostic result and do not continue to heavier graph models immediately.
```

Task85 conclusion:

```text
Task85 does not replace Task80.

The selected graph config is all-zero, so the final decoder is effectively a
no-op for relation prediction. It is useful as a graph-audit layer because it
confirms that the Task80 test prediction already has invalid=0 and wrong_dir=0,
but it does not improve micro-F1 or support-macro-F1.

The printed graph_ok improvement should not be counted as model-result gain:
Task80 metrics_summary did not contain graph_consistency_pass_rate, so the
comparison script displayed its base value as 0.0000. The real comparable
prediction metrics are unchanged.

Therefore Task83 / Task84 / Task85 are saturation checks, and the current
STIX-ORE strict final remains Task80 unless a later module obtains stable
multi-seed improvement.
```

## Next Optimization: Task86 Residual-Label Focused PU Relabeling

Task86 target:

```text
residual-label focused PU relabeling / missing positive repair
```

Motivation:

```text
Task85 shows that Task80 test predictions are already schema-valid and
direction-valid. The remaining bottleneck is less likely to be graph decoding
and more likely to be CTI training-label incompleteness:

1. CTI reports are long and relation-dense.
2. Some all-negative or partially labeled entity pairs may contain unannotated
   positive relations.
3. If these likely missing positives are treated as hard negatives during
   Task80 training, the model boundary can be biased against long-tail and
   overlap relations.
```

Task86 method:

```text
1. Export Task80 train predictions.
2. Find high-confidence predicted relations that are not in train gold labels.
3. Filter candidates with conservative PU rules:
   - relation is in target residual family
   - confidence >= min_conf
   - probability margin >= min_margin
   - no_relation_score <= max_no_relation
   - relation is in decoded pred_relations
   - schema_valid_mask allows this relation
   - max one added relation per row
   - per-relation and total caps
4. Append selected relations to train gold_relations only.
5. Retrain Task80 evidence head using the same frozen embeddings.
6. Dev/test labels remain unchanged.
```

run_cti_azerg_task86_pu_label_repair.sh
```

  exfiltrates_to, owns, targets, located_at, variant_of, uses,
  communicates_with, controls, exploits, has

min_conf=0.90
min_margin=0.03
max_no_relation=0.55
max_add_per_relation=16
max_add_per_row=1
max_total_add=80
require_predicted=true

```

The PU repair mechanism selected 17 high-confidence missing-positive candidates,
but the repaired training labels reduced test micro-F1 and correct triples.
This suggests that the current self-training style label repair still writes
some model bias back into the train set.

Task86 is kept as a saturation check:
training-label incompleteness is plausible, but naive high-confidence PU repair
is not sufficient under the current Task80 setup.
```

## Next Optimization: Task87 Relation-Specific Threshold Calibration

Task87 target:

```text
relation-specific threshold stability / per-relation dev-safe calibration
```

Motivation:

```text
Task86 shows that changing train labels is risky. Task87 therefore returns to a
safer decoding-level intervention:

1. keep Task80 checkpoint unchanged
2. keep train/dev/test labels unchanged
3. only tune relation-specific probability thresholds on dev
4. apply selected thresholds once to test
```

Task87 method:

```text
1. Read Task80 dev_predictions.jsonl and test_predictions.jsonl.
2. Start from the original decoded pred_relations.
3. For selected residual relations, try candidate probability thresholds.
4. A threshold can add or remove only that relation.
5. Dev-safe acceptance:
   - micro-F1 cannot drop
   - support-macro-F1 must improve
   - no_relation F1 cannot drop by more than 0.001
   - invalid relation rate cannot increase
   - dev bad switch count must be 0
6. Greedily accept at most a small number of relation thresholds.
7. Apply selected relation thresholds to test.
```

## Next Optimization: Task88 Joint Evidence Selection + Relation Decoding

Task88 target:

```text
joint evidence selection + relation decoding with consistency loss
```

Motivation:

```text
Task83-Task87 show that lightweight post-processing and decode calibration are
near saturation on the STIX-ORE branch. Task88 therefore changes the training
objective itself instead of changing labels or applying a router after decoding.

The goal is to make the relation head and evidence selector agree during
training:
1. relation prediction should be supported by selected evidence
2. selected evidence should be high for gold relations
3. relation probability and evidence confidence should not contradict each other
4. schema-invalid relation probabilities should be softly suppressed
```

Module structure:

```text
Task80 frozen evidence embeddings
  -> Task88 joint evidence decoder
      relation_logits
      evidence_confidence
      evidence_summary
  -> joint loss:
      BCE relation loss
      + evidence margin ranking loss
      + evidence selection loss
      + relation-evidence consistency loss
      + schema consistency loss
  -> dev-selected decoding
  -> test prediction
```

Implementation files:

```text
model/cti_joint_evidence_decoder_model.py
tools/train_cti_joint_evidence_decoder.py
run_cti_joint_evidence_decoder.sh
```

Replacement rule:

```text
Task88 only replaces Task80 if a variant satisfies all seed13 strict conditions:
1. test micro-F1 >= Task80 seed13
2. test support-macro-F1 > Task80 seed13
3. no_relation_f1 >= Task80 seed13 - 0.001
4. invalid_relation_rate <= Task80 seed13

If seed13 passes, run seed 42 and seed 2026 before updating strict final.
If seed13 fails, Task88 is recorded as a structural negative result and Task80
remains the STIX-ORE strict final.
```

Task88 conclusion:

```text
Task88 does not replace Task80 and does not continue to 3-seed validation.

The best macro variant improves support-macro-F1 (+0.0754) and correct triples
(+11), which shows that joint evidence selection can recover more long-tail
positive relations. However, it also increases predicted triples from 183 to
223, lowers micro-F1 by 0.0183, and introduces invalid predictions.

This indicates a recall-expansion failure mode: the joint objective can find
additional evidence-supported relations, but the decoder lacks a strong enough
precision/no-relation control layer. Task88 is therefore useful as a structural
ablation, not as the final model.
```

Next recommended optimization:

```text
Task89: Task88 Recall Expansion + Precision Guard Distillation

Instead of training a fully new decoder from scratch, use Task88 only as a
recall teacher and keep Task80 as the precision teacher:
1. train or reuse Task88 to generate candidate extra positives
2. accept only extra relations that pass schema validity, evidence support, and
   Task80 no-relation/precision guard
3. distill accepted extra positives into a small calibration head or guarded
   decoder
4. replacement rule remains strict: micro must not drop, sMacro must improve,
   invalid must stay 0
```

## Next Optimization: Task89 Recall Expansion + Precision Guard Distillation

Task89 target:

```text
Use Task88 as a recall teacher and Task80 as a precision teacher. Only add
Task88 extra relations to Task80 predictions if they pass dev-selected precision
guards.
```

Why Task89 follows Task88:

```text
Task88 discovered additional correct triples but over-expanded predictions:
correct +11, sMacro +0.0754, but micro -0.0183 and invalid +0.0090.

Task89 keeps the useful part of Task88:
  extra positive candidates

and blocks the risky part:
  low-confidence additions
  schema-invalid additions
  weak-evidence additions
  additions when Task80 no-relation guard is high
```

Implementation files:

```text
tools/distill_cti_recall_guard.py
run_cti_recall_guard_distillation.sh
```

Method:

```text
For each entity pair:
1. start from Task80 pred_relations
2. find Task88 pred_relations - Task80 pred_relations
3. each extra relation must pass:
   - teacher probability >= min_teacher_prob
   - teacher probability - Task80 probability >= min_margin
   - Task80 no_relation_score <= max_base_no_relation
   - schema_valid_mask permits the relation
   - optional evidence_top1 score >= min_evidence_score
4. choose guard thresholds on dev
5. apply the single selected config to test
```

Replacement rule:

```text
Task89 strict-pass requires:
1. test micro-F1 >= Task80
2. test support-macro-F1 > Task80
3. no_relation_f1 >= Task80 - 0.001
4. invalid_relation_rate <= Task80

If seed13 passes, run seed 42 and seed 2026 before updating strict final.
If seed13 fails, stop Task88/Task89 recall-distillation branch.
```

Task89 conclusion:

Task89 does not replace Task80 under the current strict rule because micro-F1 is
0.0009 below Task80.

1. it keeps invalid_relation_rate at 0

5. it recovers most of Task88's long-tail gain while avoiding Task88's invalid
   prediction problem

are correct. The next step should not retrain a larger model; it should inspect
and calibrate the added-triple set itself.

  invalid=0

  relation-specific allow/block
  min teacher probability
  min teacher-base margin
  min evidence score
  max additions by relation

Important:
  select filters on dev only, then apply exactly once to test.
```

## Next Optimization: Task90 Addition-Level Dev-Safe Filter

Task90 target:

```text
Task89 already isolated the useful optimization space to 24 added triples.
Task90 does not retrain and does not change base predictions. It only filters
Task89 additions using dev-selected addition-level guards.
```

Motivation:

```text
Task89:
added=24
added_correct=9
micro=-0.0009
sMacro=+0.0980
invalid=0

This means the recall teacher found useful long-tail positives, but 15 added
triples are still false positives. The remaining problem is not representation
learning; it is addition quality control.
```

Implementation files:

```text
tools/filter_task89_additions.py
run_cti_azerg_task90_addition_filter.sh
```

Method:

```text
1. Load Task80 dev/test predictions.
2. Load Task89 dev/test predictions.
3. Extract only additions: Task89 pred_relations - Task80 pred_relations.
4. On dev, sweep filters:
   - relation mode: all / dev_precision
   - minimum dev addition precision per relation
   - minimum teacher probability
   - minimum teacher-base margin
   - minimum evidence score
   - maximum additions per relation
   - maximum total additions
5. Apply selected config exactly once to test.
```

Replacement rule:

```text
Task90 strict-pass requires:
1. test micro-F1 >= Task80
2. test support-macro-F1 > Task80
3. no_relation_f1 >= Task80 - 0.001
4. invalid_relation_rate <= Task80

If seed13 passes, run seed 42 and seed 2026 before updating strict final.
If seed13 fails, stop Task88-90 recall-expansion branch.
```

Task90 conclusion:

```text
Task90 does not replace Task80 and is worse than Task89.

The dev-selected addition filter is not stable: it keeps 13 test additions but
only 3 are correct, and it removes many of the Task89 additions that produced
the support-macro gain. This shows that relation-level dev precision is too
noisy for addition filtering under the current small CTI dev set.

Final conclusion for Task88-90:
1. Task88 proves joint evidence selection can expand long-tail recall, but
   over-predicts and introduces invalid relations.
2. Task89 is the best result in this branch: invalid stays 0, no_rel is stable,
   correct triples increase, and sMacro improves strongly, but micro remains
   0.0009 below Task80.
3. Task90 fails to recover the last micro point and harms sMacro.

Therefore the Task88-90 branch should stop here. Keep Task89 as an important
structural ablation / optional recall-oriented model, but do not update the
STIX-ORE strict final model.
```

## Next Optimization: Task91 Recall Candidate Acceptor

Task91 target:

```text
CTI Recall Candidate Acceptor for Task88-to-Task80 Distillation
```

Motivation:

```text
Task88 can propose useful long-tail relations but over-predicts.
Task89 shows that many Task88 extra candidates are useful, but a simple guard
still leaves micro-F1 slightly below Task80.
Task90 shows dev relation-level filtering is unstable.

Task91 therefore turns the problem into candidate-level supervised learning:
given a relation that Task88 predicts and Task80 does not, learn whether this
candidate should be accepted.
```

Module structure:

```text
Task80 train/dev/test predictions
Task88 train/dev/test predictions
  -> candidate = Task88 pred_relations - Task80 pred_relations
  -> label = candidate relation in gold_relations
  -> candidate features:
      teacher_prob
      base_prob
      margin
      base_no_relation_score
      teacher_no_relation_score
      evidence_score
      schema_valid
      base/teacher pred counts
      relation support/frequency/tail flag
      relation one-hot
  -> lightweight MLP acceptor
  -> dev-selected accept threshold
  -> test additions applied to Task80
```

Implementation files:

```text
tools/train_task91_recall_candidate_acceptor.py
run_cti_azerg_task91_recall_candidate_acceptor.sh
```

Replacement rule:

```text
Task91 strict-pass requires:
1. test micro-F1 >= Task80
2. test support-macro-F1 > Task80
3. no_relation_f1 >= Task80 - 0.001
4. invalid_relation_rate <= Task80

If seed13 passes, run seed 42 and seed 2026 before updating strict final.
If seed13 fails, stop the Task88-91 recall-candidate branch and keep Task80 as
the STIX-ORE strict final.
```
